options.name: --failurerule
options.description: Failure rule with inline expression. Format: 'metric[;errorStatusCodes]'. Examples: 'ErrorRate > 0.05', 'ErrorRate > 0.05;>= 500', 'TotalTime.P95 > 5000'. Repeat to define multiple rules.

options.name: --terminationrule
options.description: Termination rule with inline expression. Format: 'metric;gracePeriod[;errorStatusCodes]'. Examples: 'ErrorRate > 0.10;00:05:00', 'TotalTime.P90 > 3000;00:02:00'. Repeat to define multiple rules.
